title: Avatar Profile (Avatar Director record)
description: A persistent, cross-campaign identity record. Not campaign-specific — lives in marketing-studio/avatars/profiles/ and is referenced by avatar_id from creative briefs and asset instructions.

wardrobe.description: Approved wardrobe options only — creative briefs must pick from this list, not invent new outfits.

approved_references.description: Paths/IDs of approved reference images for this avatar (for consistency across generations).

usage_rules.description: e.g. 'no voiceover unless requested', 'hands/torso only, no face close-ups', platform restrictions.
